source_description: Guide-level raw pseudobulk (per-cell mean UMI count per guide), Replogle RPE1 essential-gene CRISPRi screen. NOT the z-score-normalized rpe1_normalized_singlecell_01.h5ad used elsewhere for cross-context validation.
effect_definition: clip(ln((mean_perturbed_raw + pseudocount) / (mean_control_raw + pseudocount)), -clip_bound, clip_bound) - identical formula, pseudocount, and clip bound to signature_bank_k562gwps.npz (gwps_signature_bank.py), computed on raw (not CP10k- or z-score-normalized) per-cell mean counts for definitional consistency.
missing_value_handling: NaN in the effects matrix = gene untested for that perturbation (both control and perturbed raw mean count below 0.05), distinct from a numerically-near-zero measured effect. Perturbations with <min_cells_per_group total cells across all their guides are omitted entirely, not represented as zero-effect. IN PRACTICE this within-vocabulary NaN mechanism found zero cases in this file (checked directly, not assumed) - the source file's 8749-gene vocabulary was already pre-filtered upstream (min control_mean=0.055, right at this threshold; var['in_matrix'] suggests an existing QC filter). The REAL missing-value axis for this bank is vocabulary coverage: it has effects for only 8749 genes total, not the full competition panel or even K562_gwps's 8248-gene vocabulary. Any downstream combination (E08+) must treat a gene absent from this bank's vocabulary as missing information, never zero-fill it.
gene_identifier_space: HGNC gene symbols (var['gene_name']) - same identifier space as signature_bank_k562gwps.npz, the competition panel, and the scBaseCount reference.
note_on_scale: This bank's raw-count basis makes it formula-identical to the K562 bank, but the two cell lines' sequencing depth, capture efficiency, and essential-gene library composition differ - E08 must verify effect-magnitude comparability before linearly combining the two banks, not assume it from formula identity alone.
